final:
-- Phase 1: spec for UTC HH:MM:SS formatting. No capabilities are granted.

pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0
  pre n < 100
  post out.char_count() == 2
  ex pad2(7) == "07"
  ex pad2(42) == "42"
  if n < 10
    return "0\(n)"
  "\(n)"

stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  pre ts >= 0
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  let day = ts % 86400
  let h = day // 3600
  let m = (day % 3600) // 60
  let s = day % 60
  "\(pad2(h)):\(pad2(m)):\(pad2(s))"

test_stamp() =
  assert stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  assert stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  assert stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  assert stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  assert stamp(90061) == "01:01:01"

test_pad2() =
  assert pad2(0) == "00"
  assert pad2(9) == "09"
  assert pad2(10) == "10"
  assert pad2(99) == "99"
